I removed `reportSkipPromptEvent` from your last commit and force pushed. The commit is now `d7f813025e` on `origin/ccct-2713_skip_dialog_email`, replacing `cf06e91736`.

- **`PersonalIdEmailFragment.kt`:** I removed the helper and its three calls (dialog shown, Skip, Add Email).
- **`AnalyticsParamValue.java`:** I also removed `USER_PROMPT_ACTION_SHOWN` and `USER_PROMPT_INFO_SIGNUP_SKIP_EMAIL`. The commit had added them and only this helper used them.
- **`PersonalIdEmailFragmentTest.kt`:**
  - I dropped the two tests that checked the analytics calls.
  - One of them also checked that tapping Add Email keeps the user on the email screen, so I kept that part as `add email keeps the user on the email screen`.
  - The Skip path is still covered by the existing recovery-workflow skip test.
